modelFields.coverageLabel: Source-linked full-credit curriculum with proposed approved-course choices; transfer matches require separate evidence.
rulesNotes: This 120-credit baseline uses 36 unique general-education credits including three-credit UNIV 104, 12 major-foundation credits, 39 major-core credits and 33 unrestricted free-elective credits. The BIOL 102 and PSYC 101 overlaps remain counted once.
BIOL 102 also fulfills the natural-science category; PSYC 101 also fulfills the social-science category. Their 6 credits are counted once.
The capstone/internship choice is PSYC 491 or PSYC 499, not both. The proposed route selects PSYC 491.
UNIV 104 retains three credits in this baseline. An approved zero-credit determination can release those hours for electives within the published range; no waiver is assumed.
Do not automatically remove RLGN 104 at 45 transfer credits or THEO 104 at 60 transfer credits. The source permits those waivers, but this ledger retains both courses until individual evaluation.

unresolved.message: Submit official records for Liberty’s individual transfer award, admission/catalog rights, state-specific general-education additions and duplicate-learning check.

This baseline retains three-credit UNIV 104 and all listed religion requirements. It uses 33 free-elective credits within the published 27–36 range, 51 major credits counted once, and 36 unique general-education credits, totaling 120. No transfer-triggered waiver is assumed. Four distinct reviewed Study.com healthcare awards and seven reviewed Sophia awards fill the unrestricted free-elective component; no named psychology requirement is replaced by a business course.
Additional outside options may improve this route. Named university fallback courses do not establish that outside credit is prohibited.
Before registration, record accepted prerequisite credit or the published assessment results and select available sections. No assessment pass or future section availability is assumed.
Before PSYC 491, meet its published junior/senior status, 18 completed psychology credits and minimum-C prerequisite requirements. These personal grades and registration status are not assumed.

graduationRequirements.title: Graduation application
graduationRequirements.detail: Submit the degree completion application within the last semester of the anticipated graduation date.

graduationRequirements.title: Major course grades
graduationRequirements.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

obligations.title: UNIV 104 retained
obligations.notes: This baseline includes the printed three-credit UNIV 104 case and 33 unrestricted elective credits. An individually approved zero-credit case can change that allocation within the published range.

gradePolicy.detail: At least C in upper-level courses in the major.

exclusions: The full-time rate requires at least 12 semester credits; eight-week subterms are not separate billing semesters.
Program-specific, military and other eligibility-based rates are outside this standard-rate model.
Technology, completion and course-specific fees remain separate.

publishedFees.label: Online technology fee
publishedFees.eligibility: Standard online fee; waived for actively serving military and their spouses under the published policy.

institutionMinCredits.calculation: 25% of this published degree total must be completed at Liberty.

externalMaxCredits.calculation: Published degree total less the 25% institutional minimum.
externalMaxCredits.scope: Overall outside-credit ceiling only. This does not establish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling or a particular provider award.

majorInstitutionFraction.scope: 25% of the exact major/minor component, unless the degree completion plan specifies otherwise. The denominator remains degree-specific.

majorResidencyBasisCredits.calculation: The current Psychology online degree has 12 foundational and 39 core psychology credits, allocated once; the 25% major residency fraction uses this 51-credit component.

policyReview.message: The reviewed online undergraduate policy does not publish a separate aggregate alternative-credit ceiling. This route retains the 90-credit overall transfer ceiling and 30-credit Liberty minimum; no numeric alternative-credit allowance or individual award is inferred.

onlineGuideAwardReview.scope: Exact receiving awards and proposed degree placements only; provider quantities and eligibility remain separate.
